aspca_people_foods.title: People Foods to Avoid Feeding Your Pets
aspca_people_foods.quote: Allium species can cause gastrointestinal irritation and red blood cell damage.

merck_allium.title: Garlic and Onion (Allium spp) Toxicosis in Animals
merck_allium.quote: dogs and cats have been affected after ingesting raw, cooked, dehydrated, or granulated onions and garlic.

pph_grapes.title: Dog Ate Raisins
pph_grapes.quote: Ingestion of even a small amount of grapes, raisins, or currants can result in severe, acute kidney failure.

merck_chocolate.title: Chocolate Toxicosis in Animals
merck_chocolate.quote: Chocolate poisoning occurs most commonly in dogs, although many species are susceptible.
